quests.title: Whispers from below
quests.summary: The catacombs below Whitestone are stirring. Step through the doorway in the southern courtyard.

quests.title: Sweep the chambers
quests.summary: Slay 3 of the wandering catacombs dead to thin them before the bishop arrives.

quests.title: The Wyrd-knot relic
quests.summary: Recover any rare-tier item from the catacombs and bring it back to Whitestone.

quests.title: Hollow Bishop
quests.summary: Reach the boss room and end the Hollow Bishop. The way to Frostmoor opens with their fall.
